Name: (CP) Dacar Adventurer's Guild Expanded anime style portraits
Author: DacarTheGorilla
Description:
[b][color=#ff0000]**The CP version for 1.6 of this mod currently  needs Portraiture to work, once HD portraits is updated I'll change it**[/color][/b]
[color=#00ff00][b]**--Instructions for 1.6 CP for Portaiture--*[/b]
[b]Just download the mod and put it in the mods folder.[/b]
[b]In order to see the portraits you'll need Portraiture and do one of this two things:[/b]
[b]-Once inside the game press "P" (by default it may be different depending on your settings) until you see HDP[/b]
[b]-In Portraiture config setting  change this to not have to cycle through your portraits:[/b]
[b]"active": "HDP"
[/b][/color]
This mod has a version for  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] in optional files.
Third batch of portraits I made in my own style. As this one doesn't have as many characters as RSV I decided to make this one first before tackling RSV and so here it is.
This one only has the portraits for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12102?tab=articles]AGE[/url], the vanilla portraits can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19796]here[/url].

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/6509pQY9/Next-Projects.png[/img]

Next mod will be:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]ESR[/url]  and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045][color=#8e7cc3]East Scarp Seasonals[/color][/url] (I need to finish the new NPCs and clothes)

After that I will be making one of this mods if I get the okay, pretty much in this order:

- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url] ﻿
- [color=#ff0000][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999]Always Raining in the valley[/url][/color]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10770]Sen - Lurking in the dark[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6626]Lunna[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10016]Lavril[/url] (Maybe this one will have to wait till is back up)
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8606?tab=description]Juna[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31663]Eleanor[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13437]Creative Differences[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12369]Never ending Adventure
[/url]﻿

[color=#8e7cc3]AGE Seasonal[/color] will be done some other time, I need to figure out when tho
